name: dsh-egm
description: Elephant-Goldfish Model for DeepSeek Harness: upstream EGM skills unchanged, per-role model routing, and a live run view in the browser and the terminal.

scripts.check: npm run check --workspace @local/dsh-egm && npm run check --workspace @local/dsh-egm-ui && npm run check --workspace @local/dsh-workflow-view
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @local/dsh-egm && npm run test --workspace @local/dsh-egm-ui && npm run test --workspace @local/dsh-workflow-view
